import json, os, glob
d = '/root/autodl-tmp/tax_error_inject_agent/eval_results/'

        sc = s.get('success_count', s.get('correct', '?'))
        tot = s.get('total', s.get('total_cases', '?'))
        acc = s.get('accuracy', s.get('success_rate', '?'))
